details: Found outside the change by the review of wt/merge-msg, 24 Oct: the front relies on relay check show before every merge; a false open 0 sends it to a merge that is refused. IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).
failing_case: Live, today: branch wt/merge-msg (forked from master f9bc285, own commits: one gate log, no check mark).
`relay check show -C /Users/amidman/relay/.worktrees/merge-msg wt/merge-msg` prints
gate f9bc285...: exit 0
mark 6b7e6a718079124a0532ce0f57de08d255188a82: open 0, queued 0
outside: 0 in the check
The mark 6b7e6a... is another branch's, already on master (git branch --contains: master, wt/bench-set, wt/eval-close).
The merge hook's step_mark looks only at marks in `rev-list ref ^master` (relay_inert.own_marks), finds none, and
refuses "no check mark for wt/merge-msg (run relay gate, then delegate:checker on its head)".
It should print "mark: no mark yet" (and "outside: unknown (no mark yet)"), as it does when no mark is reachable.
This is the item's own failing case in another shape: check show prints open 0 while the merge is refused.
pass_cases: 1. Repo in a temp folder: master holds a mark of commit M (open 0); branch wt/a forks after it and commits lib/a.py
with no mark of its own -> show(repo, "wt/a") == ["gate: none yet" or its gate line, "mark: no mark yet",
"outside: unknown (no mark yet)"]; the merge hook refuses with "no check mark for wt/a".
2. Same, then wt/a gets its own mark with open 0 and nothing after it -> show prints "mark <that commit>: open 0,
queued 0" and three lines in all (test_t9 first half keeps passing).
3. Same as 2, then a non-inert file lib/late.py committed after the mark -> line 4 is
"1 non-inert file changed after the mark: lib/late.py; run relay gate, then delegate:checker" (test_t9 keeps passing).
4. A train branch whose own files are all covered by absorbed ready branches (step_mark returns with no mark) ->
show does not claim a refusal the merge would not make (state the line chosen, e.g. "mark: none needed, the
ready changes it holds are checked").
reason: tests/test_merge_train.py:597 test_show_ignores_a_mark_that_landed_on_the_default_branch passes at head and fails at 182e6bdd.

details: CONFIRMED by a scratch test (TrainCase subclass): INERT verdict: None; INERT show: [..., 'mark: no mark yet', ...].
judge() runs step 3 (`if not relay_inert.changed(main, merge_base, ref): return`) before step_mark; show models step_mark's
train shortcut but not step 3, so it claims a refusal the merge would not make: the brief's pass case 4 principle
("show does not claim a refusal the merge would not make"). Reachable: a lane whose only commits are a handover or check
record. The change made it worse here (before, the landed mark happened to read "open 0").
evidence: INERT show: ['gate e54e06d11aea0c04ca9f058973145073d68dd4ba: exit 0', 'mark: no mark yet', 'outside: unknown (no mark yet)']
plugins/relay/hooks/merge.py judge: `if not relay_inert.changed(main, merge_base, ref):  # 3  return`
failing_case: Repo: master holds a ready change wt/m (code, gate, open-0 mark) merged in. Branch wt/a forks after it and commits only
docs/handover.md (inert). The merge hook's judge returns None (step 3: relay_inert.changed(merge_base, ref) is empty, so
step_mark is not run). rm.show(main, "wt/a") now prints
['gate e54e06d...: exit 0', 'mark: no mark yet', 'outside: unknown (no mark yet)']
so the front is told the branch needs a check the merge would not ask for. Before this change it printed the landed mark
"open 0" (wrong sha, right answer). It should say that no mark is needed, as the train shortcut does.
fix_hint: In show, before the train shortcut: fork = merge-base(default, ref); if not relay_inert.changed(repo, fork, ref) (no own=, as
judge step 3), return lines + ["mark: none needed, no code changed", "outside: none to count"]. Add the test; sync the plugin copy.
pass_cases: 1. Fixture above (only docs/handover.md on wt/a) -> verdict("wt/a") is None and show(main,"wt/a")[1:] says no mark is needed
(e.g. ["mark: none needed, no code changed", "outside: none to count"]), not "no mark yet".
2. wt/a commits lib/a.py with no mark, after a landed mark -> show(...)[1:] == ["mark: no mark yet", "outside: unknown (no mark yet)"]
and the hook refuses "no check mark for wt/a" (test_show_ignores_a_mark_that_landed_on_the_default_branch keeps passing).
3. Train of two covered riders -> show(...)[1:] == ["mark: none needed, the ready changes it holds are checked", "outside: none to count"]
(test_show_on_a_train_of_covered_riders_claims_no_refusal keeps passing).
findings.summary: a branch whose own commits are all inert passes the merge hook (step 3) but show now prints 'mark: no mark yet'

details: CONFIRMED by timing on the live repo. Project principle 2 (Waste): waste that repeats on every run is MEDIUM and fixed
before the merge. The full-tree read of marks was there before, but the change now needs only own commits' marks, so the
read is now pure waste inside the function it rewrote; the second absorbed() is new in this change.
(gate_logs reads every gate log too; it is the gate line's own semantics and is left aside here.)
evidence: python3 -I -c '... ri.absorbed(r, ref); rm.show(r, branch); rm.marks(r, ref)'
master show 33.01s (same order before the change)
failing_case: Live repo /Users/amidman/relay, branch wt/relay-check-show-reports-a-mark-that-lan: rm.show takes 32.3 s.
marks(repo, ref) alone parses 290 marks (11.5 s), every one landed on master, and the new code then throws away all but the
commits of `rev-list ref ^default` (here none). relay_inert.absorbed(repo, ref) is computed at line 290 and again at line 312
(0.77 s each). The front runs check show before every merge, so this repeats on every merge.
It should read only the marks of the branch's own commits (<sha>.json for each sha of rev-list ref ^default) and reuse `ab`.
fix_hint: own = rev-list ref ^default minus the absorbed commits; stored = {c: get(repo, ref, c) for c in own if get(...) is not None};
pass absorbed=ab at line 312. Sync the plugin copy.
pass_cases: 1. Fixture: master holds 20 landed marks, wt/a has one own mark -> show reads (git show) at most the marks of wt/a's own
commits (count the reads with a mock of relay_marks.get), and still prints "mark <own commit>: open 0, queued 0".
2. relay_inert.absorbed is called once per show (mock count == 1).
3. The three new tests in tests/test_merge_train.py keep passing.
findings.summary: Principle 2 (Waste): show reads all 290 stored marks to keep only the branch's own, and computes absorbed() twice; one show takes 33 s live

details: CONFIRMED by the scratch probe (GATE verdict / GATE show). Same class as the item (show ready, merge refused) in the gate
shape. LOW: in the relay flow a check recorded without a gate log on its head gets an N finding (open >= 1), so an open-0
mark with no own gate is off the normal path; the printed sha also differs from the head. Size: 10 minutes.
evidence: GATE verdict: no green gate for the code at wt/a's head: code changed since: lib/a.py; run relay gate in .worktrees/a
GATE show: ['gate 727c81ca...: exit 0', 'mark 345dcb12...: open 0, queued 0', 'outside: 0 in the check']
failing_case: master holds ready wt/m (its gate log G, exit 0); wt/a commits lib/a.py and an open-0 mark of it, but no gate.
show -> ['gate G: exit 0', 'mark <a>: open 0, queued 0', 'outside: 0 in the check'] (looks ready);
the hook refuses "no green gate for the code at wt/a's head: code changed since: lib/a.py".
Show should add a line that code changed since that gate (or say "gate: none on this code").
fix_hint: After the gate line: if relay_inert.changed(repo, gate_commit, ref, archive=True) is not empty, append
"code changed since the gate: <files>; run relay gate", the test step_gate applies.
pass_cases: 1. Fixture above -> show prints a line naming lib/a.py as changed since the gate (or "gate: none yet").
2. wt/a with its own green gate on its head -> the gate line is "gate <head>: exit 0" and nothing more about the gate.
findings.summary: the gate line still counts a gate log that landed on master: a branch with no gate of its own shows master's 'exit 0' with no hint while the hook refuses
